title.narrative: Training Institute on Migration Capacity Partnership for the Mediterranean

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to contribute to building migration capacity partnerships by establishing a permanent and accredited regional training institute offering quality-assured, bespoke learning and coaching experiences that result in certification for migration actors in Southern Partner Countries. The training institute will provide access to quality, cost-effective training designed to transfer the methods, tools and approaches to respond effectively and proactively to emerging migration priorities of Southern Partner Countries at the national and regional level in line with global best practices for good governance.
The training is mainly dedicated to migration operators and technical front-line governmental as well as NGO staff while the capacity partnerships targets primarily decision makers and thought leaders.
